localFeatureDraft.listingParagraphToAdd:
FIND IDEAS NEARBY
Choose to enable Nearby for suggestions around your approximate location. Matching happens on your device using included destinations and related experiences. Refresh when you want, turn Nearby off at any time, or keep exploring without location access. Your coordinates are not saved or sent to our servers, AI or map services.
localFeatureDraft.reviewNotes: Nearby requests opt-in approximate foreground location: Android coarse access and iOS reduced accuracy by default. A one-shot reading refreshes on a new app session or return to foreground only while enabled, with manual refresh and turn-off controls. Coordinates remain in memory; only the enabled preference persists. No background tracking, user-location pin, tile centering or reverse geocoding occurs. Planning sends only the selected destination through the existing consent-based Planner flow, without coordinates, distances or a current-location label.
localFeatureDraft.storePrivacyAssessment: Nearby is processed exclusively on-device. Runtime/source checks found no origin coordinates in storage or application requests. Exact iOS5 and Android7 permissions were verified; no additional collected location category is introduced. Existing OSM-derived coarse/approximate location collection and sharing disclosures remain unchanged.

localValidation.browserRuntime: Responsive Nearby flows, consent, permission/error recovery, matching, cancellation, persistence, privacy request checks and final compact landscape/ARIA refinements passed in isolated browser contexts.
localValidation.androidExpoGoRuntime: Phone/tablet actual permission flow, coarse grant, denial/manual fallback, services-off, timeout/cancel, foreground refresh, enabled-preference persistence and turn-off checks passed.

No framework mock provider or application source override was used for that successful native check. Physical-device acquisition remains a separate field check.

apple.subtitle: Zanzibar & Tanzania trip guide
apple.promotionalText: Explore Zanzibar and Tanzania on a real map, save your favourite places, shape an AI trip draft and find a season that suits your journey.
apple.description:
Find your way to Zanzibar and Tanzania with Destination Paradise.

EXPLORE ON A REAL MAP
Browse 24 destinations across Zanzibar and mainland Tanzania. Pan and zoom, filter by interests, search places and switch between the map and a photo list. Save favourites on your device and discover related excursions and safari experiences.

SHAPE YOUR TRIP
Choose your travel month, nights, group size, budget and pace. Start with a destination or a trip idea, then chat with the AI planner after giving your permission. Review the draft and decide whether to send your conversation and contact details to the Destination Paradise team for a quote. Suggestions are a starting point; the team confirms prices, availability and booking details.

CHOOSE YOUR SEASON
See current Zanzibar weather and a month-by-month seasonal guide. The weather scene follows the reported conditions, with a pause control and support for reduced motion.

GO A LITTLE DEEPER
Explore the island food guide and dates to know. Check venue and event details before making plans.

MADE FOR PHONES AND TABLETS
Enjoy a dark navy design, clear numbered map pins, phone destination sheets and a wider map-and-sidebar layout on tablets.

No account is required. Saved places and trip preferences stay on your device. Maps, photos, current weather and AI planning require an internet connection. External experience links open the website. The app does not provide turn-by-turn navigation or confirm bookings automatically.
